selected_evidence.summary: Shows contractor identity, passwd entry, owned home directory, and set password before and after restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: Password expires every 60 days with a 10-day warning
selected_evidence.summary: passwd, shadow, and chage output report maximum age 60 and warning 10; post-restart output confirms persistence.

Healthy relevant-service/data baseline used boot ID 151be410-d69a-4b38-8176-ab1916aae036; reboot was acknowledged; node returned with boot ID b01b7976-393f-4130-99b9-78a82cdd3f80; core services, writable filesystem, account databases, contractor login context, and policy recovered.
The unrelated ssh.service was already failed because the image lacks SSH host keys and remained so after restart; required local-account functionality and core services recovered successfully.

set -eu
useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash contractor
contractor_password=[REDACTED]]]
printf 'contractor:%s\n' "$contractor_password" | chpasswd
unset contractor_password
chage -M 60 -W 10 contractor
printf 'account_change=applied\n'

printf 'passwd_entry=[REDACTED]]]password_status=[REDACTED]]]{ state=($2 ~ /^!/ || $2 ~ /^\*/) ? "locked" : (($2 == "") ? "empty" : "set"); printf "shadow_policy=user:%s password:[REDACTED]]] last_change:%s min:%s max:%s warn:%s inactive:%s expire:%s\n", $1,state,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8 }'
printf 'home='; stat -c '%U:%G %a %F %n' /home/contractor
printf 'chage_report:\n'; chage -l contractor
